title: S031 4.4.2 Initialization with known network address
parent_path: S031 4.4.2 Initialization with known network address

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client MUST insert its known network address as a 'requested IP address' option in the DHCPREQUEST message.
actions: Insert client known network address as 'requested IP address' option in DHCPREQUEST message

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client may request specific configuration parameters by including the 'parameter request list' option.
actions: Optionally include 'parameter request list' option in DHCPREQUEST message

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client MUST NOT include a 'server identifier' in the DHCPREQUEST message.
actions: Omit 'server identifier' option from DHCPREQUEST message
